svg.title: Architecture of the Nakhla IT helpdesk agent
svg.desc: The employee talks to a Gradio UI, which calls a FastAPI agent app with roles Triage, Rules, Retriever, Resolver, Verifier, Ticket writer and Approval gate. The app uses OpenRouter for the model and embeddings and reaches the helpdesk system through an MCP server.
svg.text: Our agent app: FastAPI on port 8000
